null_hypothesis: The result may be instrument drift rather than an entry edge: a long-only benchmark on this data scored +0.428R. It may be noise: random entry with the same exit structure reached +0.281R at the top of its band. With 118 trades the estimate is loose, so part of any advantage is sampling variation. The data is a PROXY: GC=F stands in for XAUUSD spot at a retail broker, so anything found here may be a property of the proxy rather than of the traded instrument. The cost model is an assumption - this data carries no bid/ask - so the edge may be an artefact of costs set too low.
rejection_criterion: Same elimination criteria: must beat long-only and exceed the random-entry band.
